title: UNMISS adopted post abolishments and output continuity
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: The retained A/RES/80/283 extraction records 91 abolished posts or positions, including 53 in Electoral Affairs. This is adopted establishment action; actual personnel actions, payroll effects and workload continuity are not verified.
testable_mechanism: Reconcile the 91 unique establishment positions to effective personnel and payroll actions, then test whether required electoral and other services migrated, ceased lawfully, or returned through overtime, temporary contracts or another unit.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Improve task routing and transition controls around already adopted changes; retain or restore necessary capability through competent authority if output continuity fails. Do not propose the same 91 abolishments as a new intervention.
safeguards: Preserve mandated electoral assistance and residual electoral focal-point capacity
Protect human rights, field safety and response coverage across all affected units
Do not substitute staff workload or unpaid overtime for an alleged cost reduction
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: The 53 Electoral Affairs posts are a subset of 91; never add them. Adopted establishment reductions and their budget effects belong in the counterfactual. Include remaining staff, consultants, overtime, contracts, separation and receiving-unit costs; authorization is not realized payroll reduction.
minimum_records: Unique position/post IDs, adopted establishment table, effective personnel actions and last payroll dates
Fund/cost-centre payroll, vacancy, separation, consultant and temporary staffing records before and after transition
Mandate-to-task map, electoral service requests, required outputs, timeliness, quality, incidents and receiving-unit workload
Approved transition decisions, residual focal-point duties and independent output-continuity review
custodian_roles_to_confirm: UNMISS Chief of Staff and electoral substantive lead
UNMISS HR, finance and mission support custodians
DPO electoral coordination and mandate owners

case_specific_limit: The case tests implementation and continuity of an already adopted action; it does not establish that all 91 occupied posts disappeared or that 53 electoral positions were unnecessary.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
